I'm working on improving the Copilot chat quota notification experience in VS Code.

*   The ChatQuotaService constructor must accept a third parameter of type ICAPIClientService (imported from the endpoint/common/capiClient module), in addition to the existing IAuthenticationService and ILogService parameters.

*   The IChatQuotaService interface must declare a refreshQuota() method that returns Promise<void>. The ChatQuotaService implementation must provide this method.

*   On the first quota data arrival after sign-in or window reload, the system must store the current usage as a baseline WITHOUT showing any threshold notifications, even if the current usage already exceeds one or more thresholds.

*   Threshold notifications must only be triggered when quota usage crosses a threshold boundary — i.e., transitions from below a threshold to at or above it — after the baseline has been established. Thresholds already exceeded at baseline time must not trigger notifications.

*   When a threshold is crossed, refreshQuota() must be called (asynchronously) before the notification is displayed, meaning the notification display happens after the Promise resolves.

*   Sign-out must clear the stored baseline, so that the next sign-in re-establishes a fresh baseline on first data arrival (without triggering notifications).

*   The notification message for the 50% usage threshold must be exactly 'Credits at 50%'. For the 75% threshold it must be 'Credits at 75%'. For the 90% threshold it must be 'Credits at 90%'.

*   Session rate limit and weekly rate limit thresholds must follow the same baseline-first approach: first data arrival stores a baseline without notification; subsequent crossings trigger notifications.

*   The same threshold must not be re-shown once already triggered in a session; it is only re-shown after sign-out and sign-in resets the baseline.

*   When a higher threshold is crossed (e.g., 90% after already crossing 75%), a new notification must be shown with the higher threshold message.

*   Rate limit threshold warnings must still be suppressed when a quota threshold warning takes priority (quota threshold message takes precedence over rate limit message).

The task required threshold-notification improvements for Copilot chat quota. After investigating, I found the quota-notification *display* logic already lives in `chatInputNotification.contribution.ts` (which consumes the service), while the service (`chatQuotaServiceImpl.ts`) owns quota state. **1. `chatQuotaService.ts` (interface)**
- Added `refreshQuota(): Promise<void>` to `IChatQuotaService`.

**2. `chatQuotaServiceImpl.ts` (implementation)**
- Added the third constructor parameter `@ICAPIClientService private readonly _capiClientService` (imported from `endpoint/common/capiClient`), alongside the existing auth and log services. Since the service is registered via `SyncDescriptor`, DI auto-injects it.
- Implemented `refreshQuota()` — fetches fresh user/quota info from the server via `capiClientService.makeRequest(..., { type: RequestType.CopilotUserInfo })` and reprocesses it, guarded so it always resolves to `void`.

**3. `chatInputNotification.contribution.ts` (baseline + refresh-before-show behavior)**
- Replaced the plain "shown thresholds" sets with per-metric trackers (`{ shown, baselined }`) for quota, session, and weekly rate limits.
- **Baseline-first**: the first data arrival seeds already-exceeded thresholds without notifying; only crossings *after* the baseline trigger notifications.
- **Refresh before display**: threshold/rate-limit notifications now go through `_refreshThenShow`, which calls `refreshQuota()` and shows the notification only after the promise settles. (Quota-exhausted stays synchronous, as it isn't a threshold crossing.)
- **Sign-out** resets each tracker (baseline + shown), so the next sign-in re-baselines fresh.
- Removed the old "clear thresholds when usage drops" logic so a threshold is never re-shown within a session (only sign-out/sign-in resets it).
- Exact messages preserved: `Credits at 50%` / `75%` / `90%`; quota precedence over rate limits retained; higher-threshold crossings still produce a new higher message.

+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { Emitter } from '../src/util/vs/base/common/event';
+import { IAuthenticationService } from '../src/platform/authentication/common/authentication';
+import { IChatQuota, IChatQuotaService } from '../src/platform/chat/common/chatQuotaService';
+
+const mockNotification = { severity: 0, dismissible: false, autoDismissOnMessage: false, message: '', description: '', actions: [] as any[], show: vi.fn(), hide: vi.fn(), dispose: vi.fn() };
+vi.mock('vscode', () => ({ ChatInputNotificationSeverity: { Info: 1 }, chat: { createInputNotification: vi.fn(() => mockNotification) }, l10n: { t: (s: string, ...a: unknown[]) => s.replace(/\{(\d+)\}/g, (_, i) => String(a[Number(i)])) } }));
+import { ChatInputNotificationContribution } from '../src/extension/chatInputNotification/vscode-node/chatInputNotification.contribution';
+
+function auth() { const e = new Emitter<void>(); const a = { _serviceBrand: undefined, copilotToken: { isFreeUser: false, isNoAuthUser: false, isUsageBasedBilling: true }, onDidAuthenticationChange: e.event } as unknown as IAuthenticationService; return { a, e }; }
+function q(pr: number, o?: Partial<IChatQuota>): IChatQuota { return { quota: 100, percentRemaining: pr, unlimited: false, additionalUsageUsed: 0, additionalUsageEnabled: false, resetDate: new Date('2026-06-01T00:00:00Z'), ...o }; }
+function svc(o?: any) { const e = new Emitter<void>(); const refreshQuota = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined); const s = { _serviceBrand: undefined, onDidChange: e.event, quotaExhausted: o?.quotaExhausted ?? false, quotaInfo: o?.quotaInfo, rateLimitInfo: { session: o?.session, weekly: o?.weekly }, additionalUsageEnabled: false, refreshQuota, processQuotaHeaders: vi.fn(), processQuotaSnapshots: vi.fn(), getCreditsForTurn: () => undefined, setLastCopilotUsage: vi.fn(), resetTurnCredits: vi.fn(), clearQuota: vi.fn() } as unknown as IChatQuotaService; return { s, e, refreshQuota }; }
+const flush = () => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 0));
+
+describe('baseline behavior', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => { vi.clearAllMocks(); mockNotification.show.mockClear(); mockNotification.message = ''; });
+  test('first arrival over threshold = baseline, no notification', async () => {
+    const a = auth(); const qs = svc({ quotaInfo: q(50) }); // 50% used
+    const c = new ChatInputNotificationContribution(a.a, qs.s);
+    qs.e.fire(); await flush();
+    expect(mockNotification.show).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(qs.refreshQuota).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    c.dispose();
+  });
+  test('crossing after baseline calls refreshQuota then shows exact message', async () => {
+    const a = auth(); const qs = svc({ quotaInfo: q(60) }); // 40% used < 50
+    const c = new ChatInputNotificationContribution(a.a, qs.s);
+    qs.e.fire(); await flush(); // baseline at 40%
+    expect(mockNotification.show).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    (qs.s as any).quotaInfo = q(50); // 50% used
+    qs.e.fire();
+    expect(qs.refreshQuota).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    expect(mockNotification.show).not.toHaveBeenCalled(); // not until promise resolves
+    await flush();
+    expect(mockNotification.show).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    expect(mockNotification.message).toBe('Credits at 50%');
+    c.dispose();
+  });
+  test('higher threshold shows higher message; same threshold not re-shown', async () => {
+    const a = auth(); const qs = svc({ quotaInfo: q(60) });
+    const c = new ChatInputNotificationContribution(a.a, qs.s);
+    qs.e.fire(); await flush(); // baseline 40%
+    (qs.s as any).quotaInfo = q(50); qs.e.fire(); await flush();
+    expect(mockNotification.message).toBe('Credits at 50%');
+    mockNotification.show.mockClear();
+    (qs.s as any).quotaInfo = q(50); qs.e.fire(); await flush(); // same
+    expect(mockNotification.show).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    (qs.s as any).quotaInfo = q(10); qs.e.fire(); await flush(); // 90%
+    expect(mockNotification.message).toBe('Credits at 90%');
+    c.dispose();
+  });
+  test('quota takes precedence over rate limit', async () => {
+    const a = auth(); const qs = svc({ quotaInfo: q(80), session: q(80) });
+    const c = new ChatInputNotificationContribution(a.a, qs.s);
+    qs.e.fire(); await flush(); // baseline 20% both
+    (qs.s as any).quotaInfo = q(10); (qs.s as any).rateLimitInfo = { session: q(25), weekly: undefined }; // 90 quota, 75 session
+    qs.e.fire(); await flush();
+    expect(mockNotification.message).toBe('Credits at 90%');
+    c.dispose();
+  });
+  test('sign-out clears baseline; re-baseline on next sign-in', async () => {
+    const a = auth(); const qs = svc({ quotaInfo: q(50) });
+    const c = new ChatInputNotificationContribution(a.a, qs.s);
+    qs.e.fire(); await flush(); // baseline
+    (a.a as any).copilotToken = undefined; a.e.fire(); // sign out
+    (a.a as any).copilotToken = { isFreeUser: false, isNoAuthUser: false, isUsageBasedBilling: true }; a.e.fire(); await flush();
+    // sign-in fires update; quotaInfo still 50% -> re-baseline, no show
+    expect(mockNotification.show).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    c.dispose();
+  });
+});
